analysis_granularity: scene-level automated analysis; not every frame
interpretation_note: Provider reported scene/audio descriptions are secondary estimates, not a measured waveform or every-frame source review.

scenes.visual_description: A pair of hands with dark purple nail polish and gold rings pulls a translucent blue ball filled with small blue beads out of a clear plastic bag. The background is a clean white surface illuminated by warm fairy lights. The camera is static and angled slightly from above.
scenes.audio_description: Upbeat, energetic pop music plays. Voiceover: This stress ball is trash!
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: A young woman, approximately 16-20 years old with fair skin and long brown hair held back by a white headband, wearing a light blue half-zip sweatshirt, looks directly at the camera with a disgusted facial expression. She waves her hand dismissively toward a blue stress ball she is holding. The background shows a shelf with small plants and a YouTube award plaque.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: But according to this video, we can fix it!
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: Split screen effect. The top half shows a close-up of a hand inserting a syringe needle into a purple beaded ball. The bottom half shows the same woman from the previous scene, now wearing clear-rimmed glasses and a white knitted vest with red patterns over a white shirt, pointing upwards toward the top video frame while smiling.
scenes.audio_description: Sounds of a syringe being handled and a slight whoosh sound effect.
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: Back to the white surface. The hands with purple nails are shown tearing open a clear plastic packaging. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy texture of the bag.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: This stress ball originally came in a Taba Squishy bag...
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: The hands remove the blue ball from the bag. The ball is large and clear, filled with bright blue water-gel beads. The hand wearing a pink ring with a smiley face is prominent.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: ...even though it isn't a Taba Squishy.
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: The hands stretch the ball, demonstrating its elasticity. A large air bubble is visible inside the ball, causing the beads to cluster at the bottom. The movement is slow to emphasize the amount of air.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: And the ball has way too much air in it. I did not sign up for this!
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: The hands hold a large, clear medical-style syringe and a long metal needle. The lighting is cool-toned on the white tabletop.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: All we need is a syringe and needle.
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: The needle is carefully inserted into the small white plastic stopper on the blue ball. The right hand pulls the plunger of the syringe upward. As the air is removed, the clear outer skin of the ball begins to shrink and wrap tightly around the blue beads.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: Put it in the stopper, and now we can slurp all the air out of it. Slurping sound effects.
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: The air is almost entirely gone. The ball now looks like a cluster of grapes rather than a smooth sphere. The hands adjust the needle to get the last bit of air.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: Oh, I think it's stuck! Whoa, the balls are sticking out!
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: The woman (in the light blue sweatshirt and white headband) holds the finished, deflated ball up to her face. She has an excited, open-mouthed expression and wide eyes.
scenes.audio_description: Voiceover: I hope this works! Three, two, one!
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review

scenes.visual_description: The hand with the butterfly ring and purple nails repeatedly squeezes the airless ball. The blue beads rub against each other under the thin clear film. The background is a purple geometric wall with a small pink floral prop and warm string lights.
scenes.audio_description: High-fidelity, loud crunching sound of the beads. Voiceover: The crunch is unreal! This is it!
scenes.evidence: automated scene-level multimodal analysis; not full-frame independent review
